infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aviora requires access to your camera to let you take photos of your boarding passes or passport for assistance verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aviora requires access to your photo library to let you upload documents and proof of assistance eligibility.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Aviora to access your photos to select document verification uploads.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Aviora to use your camera to photograph travel document verification copies.
